calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-11-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Nici Rodich.
Petitioner: Erda Yenti, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Ismail Yahya and Leila Chelsea Shaban, was sworn and examined.
Order Dispensing Notice granted and filed in court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Ismail Yenti and Leila Chelsea Yenti.
Decree signed in open court.
